name: Airplane Scheduler
tagline: Turn airplane mode on and off on a schedule
blurb: Airplane Scheduler turns airplane mode on and off on a schedule, so your phone goes quiet at night without you having to remember.
description:
Airplane Scheduler turns airplane mode on and off on a schedule, so your phone goes quiet at night without you having to remember.

Features
• Any number of schedules, one-off or repeating on any days of the week.
• Supports overnight time ranges automatically.
• Optionally turns off Wi-Fi at the start and back on at the end.
• Undoes only what it changed: airplane mode or Wi-Fi that you set yourself stays as you left it.
• An optional reminder an hour before a schedule starts if Shizuku isn't ready.
• No internet access, ads or tracking.

Note
This app requires Shizuku to function.
